plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Programming workflow & code-navigation skills: git (branches, PRs, worktrees), rq (find a definition by name), gqls (search a GraphQL schema — fuzzy/semantic, or jump to a resolver), find-skill (locate where a skill is defined), and find-gem (locate + search installed Ruby gem source).

plugins.name: personas
plugins.description: Reusable agent personas — craft & analysis experts (analyst, librarian, rubyist, scribe) and a moderator-chaired decision council (PM, hacker, staff engineer, production engineer, platform expert, skeptic) you can summon in any project. Self-contained system prompts; most critique or do.

plugins.name: statusbar
plugins.description: A compact, configurable status line — cwd, git branch/PR, session, model, context-window and rate-limit, rendered from a small Rust binary built in this repo.

plugins.name: datasets
plugins.description: Keep curated reference data where Claude can find it — markdown/csv/tsv/json/yaml files under ~/.claude/datasets with frontmatter for discovery, plus slash commands and a skill to create, list, search and show them. No binary; nothing to build.
